I can hear them whisper as we pass by
It's a bad sign, bad sign

senses.d: To say (something) softly or under one's breath, so as to be heard only by one near at hand; to utter (something) without sonant breath, without that vibration of the vocal cords which gives sonorous, or vocal, sound.
ex: Whether he whispered sweet nothings to her in Stengelese is not known, but he did call her "the best catch I ever made in my career."

senses.d: To mention privately and confidentially, or in a whisper.
ex: They might buzz and whisper it one to another.

senses.d: To make a low, sibilant sound.
ex: the hollow, whispering breeze

[…] hear thy laurel whisper sweet
About the ledges of the hill.

senses.d: To speak with suspicion or timorous caution; to converse in whispers, as in secret plotting.
ex: All that hate me whisper together against me.

senses.d: To address in a whisper, or low voice.
ex: and whisper one another in the ear
where gentlest breezes whisper souls distressed

senses.d: To prompt secretly or cautiously; to inform privately.
ex: He came to whisper Wolsey.
[A] simple youth whispered me that he was an Illuminé, and carried on an intercourse with the invisible world.

senses.d: To send a private message to an individual in a chat room.
To exercise skill in taming or training a creature.
To project intention and influence events by sending thoughts or desires outward through softly-spoken words or subtle mental or energetic means; to subject someone or something to this influence.

ety.text: From whiche ever, whiche evere, which ever, which evere; equivalent to which + -ever.

senses.d: Which ever; emphatic form of 'which'.
ex: Good heavens! Whichever button did you press to make that happen?!

senses.d: Regardless of the ... that; no matter which.
ex: It won't work, whichever buttons you press.
Whichever book you borrow, be sure to return it to the library on time.

senses.d: Any or either ... that; the ... that.
ex: Choose whichever card you like.
Borrow whichever books interest you.

senses.d: According to or depending upon which.
ex: I'll buy the red shirt or the blue shirt, whichever one is cheaper.

senses.d: Which ever; emphatic form of 'which'.
ex: These chocolates all look delicious. Whichever shall I choose?

senses.d: Irrespective of the one(s) that; no matter which one(s).
ex: Whichever you pick, be content with it.

senses.d: Any or either one(s) that; the one(s) that.
ex: I have a few books; please borrow whichever interest you.
They have lots of shirts, but I'll buy whichever is cheapest.

senses.d: Any or either one(s).
ex: I don't mind which you have. Take whichever.

senses.d: According to or depending upon which one(s).
